ENPH 253.title: Introduction to Instrument Design
ENPH 253.description: Practice in engineering design and instrument development including mechanical and electrical design, and communications with sensors, actuators. Micro-controller implementation and system integration. Engineering design review process and presentations. Engineering communication in design and product release.

ENPH 257.title: Heat and Thermodynamics
ENPH 257.description: Thermometry, thermal properties of matter; heat transfer by conduction; convection and radiation; kinetic theory of gases and gas laws; heat engines; refrigeration; change of state; first and second laws of thermodynamics.
ENPH 257.prerequisiteText: Either (a) SCIE 001 or (b) one of MATH 200, MATH 217, MATH 226, MATH 254, MATH 255; and either (a) all of PHYS 108, PHYS 109 or (b) one of PHYS 102, PHYS 153 or (c) all of PHYS 157, PHYS 158, PHYS 159 or (d) all of PHYS 118, PHYS 119 or (e) all of PHYS 108, PHYS 119

ENPH 259.title: Experimental Techniques
ENPH 259.description: Basic experimental techniques in acquisition, analysis, and presentation and communication of data and technical results.
ENPH 259.prerequisiteText: One of APSC 176, ENGL 110, ENGL 111, ENGL 112, ENGL 120, ENGL 121, WRDS 150 and either (a) all of PHYS 108, PHYS 109 or (b) one of PHYS 102, PHYS 153 or (c) SCIE 001 or (d) all of PHYS 157, PHYS 158, PHYS 159 or (e) all of PHYS 118, PHYS 119 or (f) all of PHYS 108, PHYS 119

ENPH 270.title: Mechanics II
ENPH 270.description: Dynamics: systems of particles, kinematics and kinetics of rigid bodies (plane motion), energy and momentum, rotating coordinates.

ENPH 352.title: Laboratory Techniques in Physics
ENPH 352.description: Some of the experiments will be based on the lecture material for PHYS 301. Other techniques and subjects will also be covered.

ENPH 353.title: Engineering Physics Project I
ENPH 353.description: Engineering project planning, execution and reporting. The course involves carrying out an open-ended Engineering project to meet specific performance metrics on an industry relevant topic selected by instructors. Reporting on progress is both oral and written. .

ENPH 459.title: Engineering Physics Project II
ENPH 459.description: Project planning, management and reporting. This course involves writing a project proposal, carrying out an open-ended Engineering project, and reporting the results both orally and in writing. .

ENPH 479.title: Engineering Physics Project III
ENPH 479.description: Projects designed to give students research development and design experience. Projects are provided by research faculty in Science and Engineering and from local industry. .

ENPH 480.title: Engineering Physics Project IV
ENPH 480.description: An optional course for those students wishing to continue their project work beyond the development in ENPH_V 479. .

ENPH 481.title: Entrepreneurial Projects I
ENPH 481.description: A project course for students pursuing entrepreneurial training within Engineering Physics, and wishing to further develop projects resulting from ENPH_V 459. .
